policies.policy_name: Delete Change Request Mapping – Allowed Roles
policies.description: Users with the Administrator, Manager, or Agent role are permitted to delete change‑request‑mapping records.
references: | Administrator (admin) | System Configuration & Integrity | Full CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) access across all tables. |

| Manager (manager) | Supervision, Escalation, Approvals | Full CRUD on operational tables (incident, problem, change, knowledge); READ access to all the tables. Can reassign incidents/requests. Can approve/reject Change Requests. Monitors SLAs and escalations. |

| Agent (agent) | Frontline Incident/Request fulfillment | Full CRUD on Incidents, Service Requests, Tasks, Work Notes, CMDB, Change, Problem, and Knowledge. READ access to all the tables. Can update assignment, state, and resolution. | Cannot bypass approvals, or change system administration settings. |

policies.policy_name: Delete Change Request Mapping – Disallowed Roles
policies.description: Users whose role does not include full CRUD permissions (e.g., Reporter) must be denied deletion of change‑request‑mapping records.
references: | Administrator (admin) | System Configuration & Integrity | Full CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) access across all tables. |

| Manager (manager) | Supervision, Escalation, Approvals | Full CRUD on operational tables (incident, problem, change, knowledge); READ access to all the tables. Can reassign incidents/requests. Can approve/reject Change Requests. Monitors SLAs and escalations. |

| Agent (agent) | Frontline Incident/Request fulfillment | Full CRUD on Incidents, Service Requests, Tasks, Work Notes, CMDB, Change, Problem, and Knowledge. READ access to all the tables. Can update assignment, state, and resolution. | Cannot bypass approvals, or change system administration settings. |

policies.description: Each delete_change_request_mappings call must be a single validated operation; the system must not attempt to perform the deletion if required data is missing or the current record state prevents the action.
references: Atomic Operations: Perform one validated operation at a time, except when using approved batch endpoints. Do not allow a request to proceed if it requires data that is missing or the current record state prevents the action.

policies.description: Before deleting a change‑request‑mapping record, verify that removing the mapping does not violate any mandatory dependencies or leave dangling references.
references: Referential Integrity: Before closing any record, verify that all mandatory dependencies are satisfied.

policies.description: If the invoking user’s role does not include delete authority for change‑request‑mapping records, the operation must be aborted and a 403 Forbidden error returned.
references: 403 Forbidden: Permission denied (user role lacks authority for the operation).

policies.description: If any rule in this policy document is violated while attempting the deletion (e.g., missing required role or failed integrity check), the operation must be halted and the specific policy reason reported before pausing.
references: Policy Violation: If a user request violates any rule herein, you must halt the operation and provide the specific policy reason before pausing.

policies.description: Before invoking delete_change_request_mappings, the system must verify that any provided identifiers (e.g., change_request_mapping_id, change_id, incident_id, problem_id) correspond to existing records; it must never fabricate or assume IDs and should rely only on verified API results.
references: Never assume or fabricate IDs, responses, or outcomes — rely solely on verified API results. The same is the case of optional or default arguments.
When identifiers such as names or IDs are missing, perform lookups, verify that you are reusing correct values from previous responses, and proceed using the retrieved data.

policies.description: A delete_change_request_mappings call must include at least one filter parameter (change_request_mapping_id, change_id, incident_id, or problem_id). If no filter is supplied, the operation must be halted and the missing mandatory filter reported.
references: Mandatory Fields: Any request to create or update a record must validate all mandatory fields.
User Clarification: Do not ask for further information. If the request is ambiguous, return the list and state the ambiguity. If a mandatory field is missing, state which field is required.

policies.description: When delete_change_request_mappings is called with more than one filter, all provided filters must be combined using AND logic; the deletion must only occur if a record matches every specified criterion.
references: Atomic Operations: Perform one validated operation at a time, except when using approved batch endpoints. Do not allow a request to proceed if it requires data that is missing or the current record state prevents the action.

policies.policy_name: Work Log Requirement for Deletion Operations
policies.description: Any execution of the delete_change_request_mappings tool must generate a work‑log entry that records the timestamp (created_on) and the user_id of the person performing the deletion, to satisfy audit and compliance requirements.
references: Time Tracking: All work logs must include the timestamp (created_on) and the user_id performing the action.

policies.policy_name: Rate Limiting Compliance for Deletion Operations
policies.description: If a delete_change_request_mappings request exceeds the allowed rate limit, the operation must be paused and retried using exponential backoff as defined by the system's rate‑limiting policy.
references: Rate Limiting: If exceeded, pause and retry using Exponential Backoff.

policies.description: If a delete_change_request_mappings request encounters a 409 Conflict response (e.g., record locking or state conflict), the operation must be aborted and the conflict must be reported to the user.
references: 409 Conflict: Record locking or state conflict.
